description: Find open research datasets you are allowed to use: searches Zenodo (700k+ records) and gives each dataset a plain licence verdict read from the depositor's structured licence. $0.004 per call over x402 (USDC on Arc, Base or Solana, or XNT on X1). Call once without `payment` for the terms, sign them with your own wallet, call again with `payment`.

payment.description: a signed x402 payment (the base64 payload you would put in PAYMENT-SIGNATURE). Pass it and the purchase completes inside this tool call.

q.description: what you are looking for, e.g. "electricity prices"

name: dataset_finder
